title: Research: audit dyadic admission of QQ16 unread minors
body:
## Summary

Add `research/qq16-dyadic-unread-minors/`, a scoped coefficient-ring audit of QQ16 retained-cut decoding.

```text
PR2443 unread basis H0          determinant -32, dyadic inverse
one unread exchange, 2 to 25   determinant -80, inverse entry 1/10
radius-two census              107889 sets, 2501 nonsingular odd-factor minors
```

The explicit constant-owner input puts all permitted observations in the ideal `5 Z[1/2]` while a required original coordinate is 1. This excludes finite dyadic-linear complete-input decoding for that alternative read set under the fixed observations. The original H0 still passes. The statement covers the specified dyadic and Gaussian-dyadic rings, not normalized Clifford coefficients outside those rings, nonlinear division, new observations or selected-input-only recovery.

Card `joint-query-controller`, priority revision 4. This is a documented scalar-admission side result after the initial paid-observation question proved covered, not a completed controller. Scientific base is `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.

Credit Gareth Davidson / #2432 for the unread-column criterion, starship-s / #2443 for the rational two-cut decoder, thakrarsagar / #2470 for the separate retention census, and Ali Romman / the retained QQ16 lineage. Primary contract pin: #2443 at `545c05e17243c962b112b91e7f84b4c1a41de7b8`. Exact remaining pins and credit are in the package.

[Tested artifact](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/3aff4ccbfaa1005e5093e95535e4d99aa3813e54/research/qq16-dyadic-unread-minors)

## Evidence

- **Before:** rational nonsingularity permits the alternative minor but does not establish dyadic scalar admission.
  **After:** an explicit ideal-preservation witness rejects that decoder; the original basis is a positive control. Separate determinant-lemma and direct Bareiss/cofactor implementations agree on all 107889 candidates: 59023 dyadic-unit, 2501 odd-factor and 46365 singular.
- The registered replay passes, including both complete censuses, exact inverses, six mathematical controls and five entrypoint tests. Source/receipt corruption and a mutated histogram fail as intended. Default replay is read-only.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-dyadic-unread-minors
```

Checked with CPython 3.12.15 on Linux x86_64 / WSL2. Native reads, sustainable retention, hosting, precision, all-size admission and a complete supplier bill remain unproved. No selected cold replay, new supplier or new kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only this opt-in research package is added. Selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged. The coefficient-ring restriction must remain attached to the obstruction; it is not a universal native-controller impossibility result.
